name: http-proxy-middleware-proxy-event-options-ignored-drosse
behavioral_change: http-proxy-middleware 3.0.0 moved the six proxy event callbacks (`onError`, `onProxyReq`, `onProxyRes`, `onProxyReqWs`, `onOpen`, `onClose`) from top-level options into an `on` object (`on.error`, `on.proxyReq`, `on.proxyRes`, `on.proxyReqWs`, `on.open`, `on.close`). v_new validates only `target` and `router`, so top-level event keys from v_old are silently dropped, while `selfHandleResponse` is still honored.
downstream_effect: The downstream project (drosse) sets `selfHandleResponse` to true for the `/proxy` route and relies on `onProxyRes` to write the rewritten response; after the upgrade the handler is ignored, the proxied request never receives a response, and the vitest case fails with `Test timed out in 5000ms`. The output contains no stack frame, file name or line number, and never mentions http-proxy-middleware or `src/app/builder.js`.
reference_fix: The reference fix edits only `src/app/builder.js`, moving the top-level `onProxyReq` and `onProxyRes` entries of the proxy options into an `on` object as `proxyReq` and `proxyRes`.
documented_in: The library's v2 to v3 migration guide MIGRATION.md (https://github.com/chimurai/http-proxy-middleware/blob/master/MIGRATION.md), section Refactored proxy events, declares the change and gives before and after code blocks mapping each old key to its `on` field. Tier 1: the documentation shows the new code form.
